Results.ReviewText: The Weber Master-Touch grill is a great kettle grill! It comes with a warming rack, charcoal baskets and hinged Gourmet BBQ System cooking grate. The Master-Touch can grill, smoke, and barbecue with precise control. The Weber Master-Touch is a best buy!
Results.Title: A Complete Controllable Cooking System

Results.ReviewText: This is the third Weber kettle I have owned in the last 30 years. This is a testament to how well they are built, as the second Weber is still in service (at my shop) and it is going on 15 years old. The small improvements made over the decades are very nice, but do not compare to the real value - and that is longevity. Best bang for the buck and a darn solid grill. I love it!
Results.Title: Weber is the best value, period.

Results.ReviewText:
This is a great little charcoal kettle grill as you'd expect from Weber. I like the extras that this master-touch model has. The removable center of the grill grate as well as the hinging sides are great. I haven't used the bun warmer piece yet. 

Pros: The aforementioned grate features. Large cooking surface area. Easy assembly. Ash collection.

Cons: The legs don't feel very sturdy and it wobbles a bit. Basically everything below the kettle and ash collector feel a bit cheap.

Results.ReviewText:
Customer Service - 5 stars
Product - 4.5 Stars only because I expected the highest quality from Weber the first time itself because they have been in business for a long time. 

I received the ocean blue Weber Kettle Grill as a gift. The color is really beautiful and has a pleasing shine to it in the sun. The unit was packaged nicely and was without any visible imperfections except for something that looks like a dent or a bad paint job on the lid. I was willing to overlook that imperfection, however, the day after installing everything I noticed that the paint at the contact between the lid and it's top handle started chipping away. I suspect this may be either a bad paint job or a problem with the type of Ocean Blue paint. Anyways, customer service responded to my concern within a day and offered to send a new lid immediately. The new cover has no imperfections. I appreciate the Weber customer service team for resolving the issue very quickly.

I smoked wings and grilled burgers on the unit until now. I am still learning to control the temperature properly on the unit. Occasionally smoke leaks from under the lid at some points but that should go away with more usage. The cleanup is pretty easy except for the ash flying around but then that is expected with a charcoal grill :)

Overall I am satisfied with the product and look forward to cooking with it more.

Results.ReviewText:
I have had it for a few months and it is living up to it's legend.  For burgers over direct heat it is sweet doing the job without flare ups and perfect heat.  It's ability to indirect cooking is what sets it apart though, I am cranking out babyback ribs and salmon and meatloaf and pizza and everything is awesome even the first attempts.  Pitts and Grills here in Springfield, MO is where I got it and they set me up with the vortex.  I use it to start my coals like a chimney and leave them in for indirect cooking.  

Overall it is changing the way I grill and is opening up lots of methods and awesome results.

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
